description: UDAAN 22nd District Interact conference held on Friday 9th October at Deenanath Mangeshkar Hall, Vile Parle East, Mumbai - 400049 hosted by RC Mumbai Juhu. 482 students participated from 31 Interact clubs. Our interact club of Marwari Commercial High (MCH) School registered 8 students for Group Dance competition and 19 students in Art Competition. Non participation registered for 10 students. (Total 37 students participated). Our club got a trophy for the farthest registration.
